_source: Hand-written to the Messages API response shape (content blocks, stop_reason, usage); not captured from the live API. The rule numbers in the reply come from the imported rules table (dist/data/regulations.json, Central), not from the model.
description: A real get_rules call (TA-A0) that returns a stale row: the guard does not fire, so the reply may quote the rule, and it says double-check with the rules link.

content.text: Vermilion count toward the 10-fish rockfish limit, at most 2 vermilion/sunset per angler (CDFW Central Region rules). That rule is due for review, so double-check before you keep one: {{link:rules:vermilion}}
